summary: Completed comprehensive testing of OpenVoice TTS Clone with new real-time streaming TTS feature. All backend APIs and frontend UI components working correctly.
passed_tests: POST /api/stream-tts returns SSE stream with start/chunk/done events
POST /api/stream-tts with short text generates 1 chunk and returns combined audio
POST /api/stream-tts with long text generates multiple chunks progressively
Frontend streaming section visible with REAL-TIME badge
Frontend STREAM GENERATE button triggers streaming and shows progress bar
Frontend chunk playlist shows individual chunks with status indicators
Frontend combined audio section appears after stream completes
All existing features working: TTS, voices, compare, chat, history, audiobook
Health check endpoint returning correct status
